# Kome.Records known-answer vectors. tests/test_records.adb reads them.
# One vector per line: <case> <bytes hex> <h hex>. "#" starts a comment.
# Provenance: an independent Python reference made these vectors. The
# reference uses the DESIGN.md §2 layout text and offset table, not
# Kome.Records. The script is at the end of this file, on the "#|" lines.
# It prints everything above them, with this command:
#   sed -n 's/^#| \{0,1\}//p' records.txt | python3 -I -
# It uses hashlib.blake2b (digest_size=32) for h, for ns = BLAKE2b-256
# (root_pk || salt)[0:16] and for the certificate hash. Tags: ROSTER 0,
# REVOKE 1, GRANT 2, DEL 3, PUT 4.
# For a record, <bytes> is the frame without its 64-byte signature (tag ||
# content), and h = BLAKE2b-256 (tag || content). The test builds the same
# record with Make_* and compares Content_Bytes, Hash and Encode (with a
# zero signature). For cert1, <bytes> is the 63-byte certificate input
# "kome/root" || ns || signer || u48 (cap), and h is Cert_Hash.
# Filler: fill(n, s)[i] = (s + 7 i) mod 256; DAY = 86 400 000 ms.
#   put1     ns=fill(16,1) ent=fill(16,2) field=fill(5,3) t=0x010203040506
#            seq=7 author=fill(32,4) value=fill(10,5)
#   put2     same ns, ent, author; field=fill(32,6) t=0 seq=2^48-1, empty value
#   del1     same ns, ent, author; t=1234 seq=2^48-1
#   roster1  root_pk=fill(32,8) salt=fill(16,9) signer=fill(32,10)
#            cert_cap=5000 cert_sig=fill(64,11) box_pk=fill(32,15) gen=3
#            ceiling_t=1000 del_ttl=30 DAY epoch=513 links=fill(148,12) (2)
#            members=fill(272,13) (2)
#   roster2  same root_pk, salt; signer=root_pk, zero cert block,
#            box_pk=fill(32,16), all integers 0, no links, no members
#   roster3  same root_pk, salt; signer=root_pk, zero cert block,
#            box_pk=fill(32,17), gen=ceiling_t=2^48-1, del_ttl=3650 DAY,
#            epoch=65535, links=fill(1110,18) (15), members=fill(8704,19) (64)
#   revoke1  same root_pk, salt, signer, cert_cap=5000, cert_sig=fill(64,11);
#            sign_pk=fill(32,14) from_t=777
#   grant1   same root_pk, salt, signer; cert_cap=2^48-1 cert_sig=fill(64,20)
#            subject=fill(32,21)
#   cert1    ns of (root_pk, salt), signer=fill(32,10), cap=0x000001020304
put1 0401080f161d242b323940474e555c636a020910171e252c333a41484f565d646b05030a11181f010203040506000000000007040b121920272e353c434a51585f666d747b828990979ea5acb3bac1c8cfd6dd000a050c131a21282f363d44 bfb7b6c91d606f99096f0870234100f6b907c70ae8d0826d4b665fe4c6753835

#| def b2(data):

#|
#| def fill(n, s):

#|
#| def u16(v):

#| def ns_of(root_pk, salt):
#|     return b2(root_pk + salt)[:16]

#| def roster(root_pk, salt, signer, cap, cert, box_pk, gen, ceil, ttl, epoch, links, members):
#|     assert len(links) % 74 == 0 and len(links) // 74 <= 15
#|     assert len(members) % 136 == 0 and len(members) // 136 <= 64

#|     return c

#|     assert len(i) == 63
#|     return i
#|
#| NS, ENT, AU = fill(16, 1), fill(16, 2), fill(32, 4)
#| RT, SA, SG = fill(32, 8), fill(16, 9), fill(32, 10)
#| DAY = 86_400_000
